def VTask.extend {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} {γ : Sort u_3} (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (j : β → γ) : β → γ :=
  fun b => if h : ∃ a, f a = b then
    -- If there exists an `a` such that `f a = b`, then use classical choice to select one such `a`
    -- and apply `g` to it.
    g (Classical.choose h)
  else
    -- If no such `a` exists, then apply the fallback function `j`.
    j b
